channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump scolds Germany’s Merz for criticism of Iran war
item.description: US president says German chancellor 'doesn't know what he's talking about', defends war on Iran as necessary.

item.title: After 60 days of war in Iran, does US Congress want a say?
item.description: Under law, Trump needs Congressional approval to continue war, experts say, but Congress may avoid the issue altogether.

item.title: Massive explosion from Israeli operation seen in southern Lebanon
item.description: Video captured massive explosions in southern Lebanon in what the Israeli military called strikes on a Hezbollah tunnel.

item.title: Can the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty prevent a disaster?
item.description: The United Nations chief warns of the waning influence of the global agreement.

item.title: Trump approval dips to record low amid Iran war, inflation woes: Poll
item.description: Only 22 percent of US voters back the president's performance on the cost of living, Reuters/Ipsos survey suggests.

item.title: Ukrainian drones strike Russia’s Tuapse refinery for third time
item.description: Ukraine targeted a major Russian oil refinery in the Black Sea port city of Tuapse for the third time within two weeks.

item.title: Is a US-Iran deal still possible?
item.description: As the Strait of Hormuz stays largely shut and Washington sends mixed signals, talks run through Islamabad and Moscow.

item.title: UAE leaves OPEC in blow to oil cartel amid war on Iran
item.description: The United ‌Arab Emirates has announced it’s withdrawing from OPEC and OPEC+.

item.title: Ukraine accuses Israel of receiving shipments of grain 'stolen' by Russia
item.description: Israel's foreign minister says it has received no evidence to support the claim that a vessel carrying grain from occupied Ukraine has reached Haifa.

item.title: Pakistan accused of attacking Afghan university
item.description: Air attacks on the province of Kunar have killed at least seven people and injured 75, sources tell the BBC.
